KSCL|20180930|con.convention: *** READ BEFORE APPLYING - KSCL's STORED con SERIES IS THE **TOTAL** ROW, NOT OWNERS. *** KSCL has real, non-nil non-controlling interests in every column, so 'Net Profit after Tax (V-VI)' and 'Attributable to: Equity Share Holders of the Company' are materially different numbers. Our stored series matches the TOTAL row exactly on THREE separate quarters and matches the owners row on NONE: stored 20190930 = 13.52 == total 1,352.35 lakhs (owners 1,363.07 -> 13.63); stored 20191231 = 8.53 == total 852.86 (owners 825.46 -> 8.25); stored 20200331 = 7.61 == total 761.08 (owners 757.35 -> 7.57). The three cells below are therefore written on the TOTAL basis so the series stays internally consistent - writing the project-standard owners figure into three cells of an eight-cell total-basis series would manufacture exactly the MIXED-convention defect the protocol names (NMDC / BHARATFORG / JKCEMENT / KIRLFER). The owners value for each cell is recorded in 'owners_alt' so a future convention sweep can flip the WHOLE KSCL con series in one pass. This series-level deviation is logged as an anomaly in refusals_B.json - it is a pre-existing condition, not something these three cells create. Unit is '(Rs In Lakhs)' on every KSCL statement; all values below are lakhs/100 rounded to 2dp.
